description: A small pumpkin patch in Dallastown, PA, Raab's Fruit Farm grows Blackberries, Apples, Peaches, Cherries, and Pumpkins. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
